dara (PM): Quick preflight for GA governance. I uploaded the acceptance checklist. Need owners for SLA sentence, SLO numbers, monitoring alerts, runbook CLI snippets, pricing footnote, and legal signoff. Please ack and call blockers.

noah (SRE): I'll own SLOs + alert rules + fallback play. Two asks: confirm whether we gate on p95 or p99 for long-tail models, and permission to run a canary steering rehearsal in staging.

claire (Product): Product prefers p95 for customer-facing latency guidance and p99 as an internal SLO. We can expose p95 publicly and keep p99 in the ops runbook. Product also wants a short Sales line about Dedicated SLAs.

mike (Sales): Safe one-liner: "Dedicated deployments are eligible for contractual SLAs; pricing & credits negotiated with your account team." Legal will need final wording.

tess (Docs): I'll author the public GA readiness doc and the internal runbook. Need the exact PromQL alerts and the CLI/API snippet to trigger model fallback or steering. ETA: Fri if SRE provides artifacts.

noah (SRE): Draft SLOs (proposal): hosted availability=99.95%, latency_p95<=200ms, latency_p99<=350-400ms (model dependent). dedicated availability=99.9%, latency_p95<=350ms. Auto-fallback policy: on error_budget_burned >50% in 1h -> steer to quantized-safe variant + engage reserve pool. We'll add a canary window and an automated rollback step.

noah (SRE): Example alert (placeholder):
```promql
(sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.04
```
CLI fallback example (placeholder):
```bash
redwood traffic shift --from model-v2 --to model-v2-qtz --policy fallback --reason error_budget_high
```
I'll paste exact flags into the runbook.

legal-bot: Reminder: public SLA statementsrequire legal review. Include credit cap, exclusions, and a customer notice window for maintenance.

claire (Product): For launch gating Product will sign off if: public docs published, internal runbook + CLI snippets in #eng-oncall, oncall rota confirmed for GA week, SLO doc committed, and provisional pricing page with a Dedicated footnote. Premium SLA lanes OK to ship post-GA.

mike (Sales): That one-liner works for prospects short-term. I'll route credit calc to legal once I draft it.

tess (Docs): Once noah drops PromQL + CLI examples I'll include them verbatim and link the observability dashboard (staging + prod) in the runbook.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging canary schedule open 1736060000-1736063600.

dara (PM): Action items: noah finalize SLO doc + PromQL + CLI examples -> Thu EOD (1736080000); tess publish GA readiness doc + internal runbook draft -> Fri (1736166400); mike draft customer-facing SLA sentence + internal credit calc -> Mon (1736252800); claire decide premium SLA gating (post-GA vs pilot) -> Mon (1736252800); deploy-bot confirm canary slot -> Tue (1736329200). Add blockers to the acceptance sheet link in the checklist.

noah (SRE): I'll run the canary steering rehearsal in staging and report impact on latency.

claire (Product): ack.

mike (Sales): ack.

tess (Docs): ack, will ping #eng-oncall for review.

dara (PM): If no objections by Thu EOD we'll mark "Ready for greenlight" and schedule the readout. :white_check_mark:
